They say they train on your “deidentified data”

Passing your output through a second model and telling it to remove identifying data would count as “deidentified”

So they could scrape all the IP in your company as long as they take the names out first…

(If those numbers are accurate, personally - I have "opinions" about the legitimacy of Trumps numbers)

Also - in-my-opinion, complacency around "not voting" means tacit acceptance of whomever arrives.

The lack of any large-scale, on-going citizen protests, disruptions (general strikes), seems to indicate the same - but I sure hope I am wrong and things may shift a little with their upcoming midterms (if they are legitimate).

OTOH, perhaps the various media (traditional and social) platforms have been doing some "calming" around stories of various protests to avert large-scale social disruptions... (We certainly can't trust the various executives/boards of those organizations when you track who/when they have been donating money and "gifts" too, and which events their leadership have attended...)

comment_text.value:
You’re right, the “both sides” claim really doesn’t work here.

Biden’s student loan forgiveness would have amounted to a gift of potentially hundreds of thousands of dollars to his most ardent supporters: young, college educated, poor people.

Trump’s proposal is a fraction of that, and all Americans would be eligible. If he’s trying to buy votes, he’s going to need to try a lot harder. This proposal is nothing like Biden’s vote buying scheme.
